panels.description: Late afternoon on the Keel pit rim. Keel lies in shadow, Halyard catches gold and Oasis remains bright. The sealed mine entrance is at far left. A WATER WARS MEMORIAL plaque stands above a dry cracked fountain. Alex sits on the railing with a packed lunch while Ada approaches carrying two battered metal mugs. Reserve the upper-left for the caption and upper-right for Ada’s balloon.

Ada offers Alex one mug. His mug is halfway to his mouth; her ration card hangs at her hip with one day’s mark punched out. Keep both faces and mugs unobstructed. Reserve separate upper and lower corners for the alternating dialogue.

Alex and Ada sit side by side on the railing with mugs in hand. Ada laughs; Alex gives a short dry laugh that does not reach his eyes. Leave negative space above each character for a clean alternating balloon path.

Split eyelines: Alex looks upward toward Oasis while Ada looks down toward Keel. The railing cuts diagonally between them. Place Alex’s lines in the left-side sky pocket and Ada’s lines in the right-side basin pocket, with enough vertical separation that no balloons overlap.

items.speaker: ALEX
items.text: The birthday special? Not sure I can afford it.

items.speaker: ALEX
items.text: Where'd you get enough water for two?

items.speaker: ADA
items.text: Not everything has a price, Alex.

items.speaker: ALEX
items.text: Every birthday... I look up there... and wonder what it feels like to wake up somewhere you get to choose your own future.

items.speaker: ADA
items.text: I look down here... and wonder why everyone gave up trying to change it.

items.speaker: ADA
items.text: That's the problem. People stopped trying to make it worth staying.
